metadata.description: Dolma multi-epoch / paraphrase scaling-law dataset — the exact pool behind the one-go triple joint fit (writeup.md §6).

conventions.D_tokens: fresh unique Dolma tokens = chinchilla_scale * 20 * N
conventions.D_prime_tokens: second-stream tokens: (epochs-1)*D for repeat, tokens_trained - D for paraphrase, 0 for 1epoch

filters.note: u-shape overfit (scale, epoch) pairs are excluded from the repetition stream; 1-epoch and paraphrase use no scale floor beyond paraphrase_scale_min.

model.loss: L = E + A/N^alpha + B/(D + eta_src * D')^beta
model.eta: eta_src = R*_src (1 - exp(-x/R*_src)) / x,  x = D'/D
model.R_star: log R*_src = log K_src + rho_src * log(D/N) + sigma_src * log N
